component.name: DSH Desktop (Community)
component.summary: Unofficial community Linux desktop build based on DeepSeek Harness

description.p: Community Linux packaging of the Electron desktop from the DeepSeek Harness open-source project. This build is unsigned, unofficial, and not affiliated with DeepSeek. Prefer adding an API key from platform.deepseek.com.
**Not an official DeepSeek product.** Name and icon are community marks (DSH) to avoid trademark confusion with DeepSeek Harness.
**Credentials and plugins** live under ~/.dsh. The Flatpak sandbox may limit Host/plugin access to host project trees compared with the AppImage/deb.
Based on upstream dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3 with community Linux packaging patches (API-key UX, Wayland drag, SIGINT exit, /opt layout).
